gallery.label: Car · DA X 1953
gallery.note: The common shape: two letters, group d. `GermanPlates.car`.

gallery.label: Short · M A 1
gallery.note: Three characters — the shortest plate the law issues.

gallery.label: Two letters, two digits · FR OM 93
Three-letter area code · CUX DP 150
gallery.note: Eight characters, the cap. Group e behind a three-letter code would be nine, and throws.

gallery.label: Tax-exempt · green ink
gallery.note: An ambulance, a tractor, a farm trailer. Only the ink changes — the euroband stays blue.

gallery.label: Historic · HL TL 15H
gallery.note: Thirty years old and preservation-worthy. The H is printed hard against the serial.

gallery.label: Electric · LER OO 39E
gallery.note: Plug-in, per the 2015 Electric Mobility Act. Eight characters with the E counted.

gallery.label: Seasonal · March to October
gallery.note: Two months, rule between them. 11 over 03 is a winter vehicle — neither has to precede the other.

gallery.label: Dealer · 06
gallery.note: Moved between vehicles for test drives and transfers.

gallery.label: Collector · 07
gallery.note: The seal alone, no inspection sticker: these vehicles are not in regular service.

gallery.label: Short-term · 04 · yellow band
gallery.note: Four weeks at most — transfers, test drives, temporary registration.

gallery.label: Export · red band
gallery.note: Ausfuhrkennzeichen, up to a year. The same plate as the 04; the band colour is the difference.

gallery.label: Y-751 957
gallery.note: The Y is a slot, and GermanBundeswehrValidator is what says it must read Y.
